rules.contract: Unqualified bacon is reviewed as the conventional unprepared cured-pork ingredient. This is a generic fallback, not proof that every market label excludes turkey/meatless bacon or has the same cure/salt/fat formulation.
rules.pattern: ^(?:a - )?bacon$|^bacon strips$|^diced bacon$|^chopped bacon$|^thick bacon pieces$|^bacon pieces, cut into quarters$|^bacon slice, cut into 4 pieces$|^bacon slices, cut (?:3 cm wide|into quarters)$|^pieces of bacon, cut into 4$|^a - bacon \(cut into 2 cm-wide pieces\)$

rules.contract: The target explicitly states fresh mint leaves; chopping is presentation only. Spearmint is the retained generic fresh culinary-mint reference.
rules.pattern: ^(?:chopped fresh mint leaves|fresh chopped mint|freshly chopped mint leaves)$

rules.contract: Unqualified culinary mint is reviewed against the retained fresh spearmint reference. This does not certify mint species or an essential-oil/peppermint-extract identity.
rules.pattern: ^(?:mint|washed mint|finely chopped mint|mint, a little|mint, a little for finishing|mint, as needed|mint, chopped)$

rules.contract: Leaf/sheet gelatine is the dry unsweetened gelatin ingredient; the retained record is powder form, so bloom strength, sheet mass and exact moisture/form are not inferred.
Apple compote is reviewed against generic cooked applesauce as a retained fruit-puree category fallback. Added sugar, chunk size and exact concentration are not certified.
Grating does not change coconut identity; because no drying/sweetening qualifier is present, use the generic fresh-coconut reference. This is not proof of moisture or cultivar.
Coconut flakes are reviewed against retained dried/desiccated coconut. Sweetening/toasting is not stated and therefore not claimed; this remains a generic fallback.
rules.fdcDescription: Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

rules.contract: Unqualified soybean flour uses the retained full-fat raw soy-flour reference. Defatting, roasting and manufacturer formulation are not inferred.
Unqualified sweetcorn is reviewed as fresh raw kernels for generic per-100-g estimation. Frozen/canned/cooked state and cultivar are not inferred.
rules.fdcDescription: Corn, sweet, yellow and white kernels, fresh, raw

rules.contract: Nori is a dried edible seaweed sheet/flakes ingredient. The retained record is generic dried seaweed, not an exact laver species, seasoning or toasted formulation.
rules.pattern: ^(?:nori seaweed|thinly sliced nori seaweed|nori for sushi|sheet of nori seaweed|shredded nori \(for garnish\), a little|shredded nori, a little for finishing)$

rules.contract: Rice vermicelli is reviewed against dry rice noodles as the as-purchased recipe input. Soaking/cooking water uptake is not inferred.
Silken tofu is reviewed against the retained soft-tofu category. Coagulant, brand, firmness and water content are not claimed exact.
rules.fdcDescription: Tofu, soft, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
rules.pattern: ^silken tofu, scooped into large pieces with a spoon$

rules.contract: Plain tofu cut into cubes is reviewed against generic raw firm tofu. Cutting is presentation only; coagulant and firmness are generic assumptions.
rules.fdcDescription: Tofu, raw, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate

rules.contract: The ingredient is an uncooked veal cutlet cut into pieces. The retained cutlet reference is used generically; exact leg cut/trim and fat ratio are not certified.
rules.fdcDescription: Veal, leg, top round, cap off, cutlet, boneless, raw

rules.contract: Unqualified chicken with only cutting/boneless wording is reviewed against generic raw chicken meat. Skin, bone, exact cut and solution treatment are not inferred.
rules.fdcDescription: Chicken, broilers or fryers, meat only, raw
rules.pattern: ^(?:chicken|chicken pieces|boneless chicken, cut into small pieces|chicken \(500 g\)|chopped chicken)$

rules.contract: Escalope/cutlet/fillet/tenderloin wording is reviewed against generic boneless skinless raw chicken breast. Breading, cooking and exact sub-cut are not inferred.
rules.pattern: ^(?:chicken escalope|chicken escalopes|chicken cutlets|chicken fillet \(in bite-sized pieces\)|chicken fillet pieces|chicken schnitzels|chicken tenderloin, cut into cubes)$

rules.contract: Young chicken is reviewed as a raw broiler/fryer meat-and-skin reference. Whole-bird bone yield and exact edible portion are not inferred.
rules.fdcDescription: Chicken, broilers or fryers, meat and skin, raw

rules.contract: Generic dried chili flakes use the retained red/cayenne pepper spice reference. Pepper cultivar, heat level and flake-versus-ground form are not exact.
Species-unspecified minced/ground meat maps directly to the retained ground-meat NFS category; no species or fat ratio is invented.
Stewing beef maps directly to retained beef stew meat; dicing is presentation only.
Beef shin is represented by retained raw beef shank. Grade, trimming and lean-only composition are not claimed exact.
rules.fdcDescription: Beef, shank crosscuts, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/4" fat, choice, raw

rules.contract: Turkey breast pieces are reviewed against a raw meat-only turkey-breast reference. Added solution and exact manufacturer treatment are not claimed exact.
rules.fdcDescription: Turkey, breast, from whole bird, meat only, with added solution, raw

rules.contract: Shimeji is reviewed as the retained beech-mushroom food identity; no cooked/dried state is stated.
Panko is a dry breadcrumb product; use the retained plain dry breadcrumb reference while keeping coarse Japanese crumb structure/formulation generic.
The ingredient identity is baking soda/bicarbonate; “mixed with flour” is preparation context, not a different leavening agent.
rules.pattern: ^(?:baking soda|bicarbonate of soda)(?:,)? mixed with flour$

rules.contract: Rapeseed cooking oil is reviewed against retained canola oil as a generic low-erucic rapeseed-oil reference. Exact cultivar/refining profile is not certified.
Semi-skimmed milk is represented by the retained reduced-fat 2% milk category. Exact European fat percentage, fortification and brand are not certified.
White mustard seed is represented by retained mustard seed; the reference is ground, so seed color/whole-versus-ground presentation is not claimed exact.
Plain pasta shapes without a cooked/fresh qualifier are reviewed as dry as-purchased pasta. Enrichment, egg content, shape and cooking-time formulation remain generic.
rules.pattern: ^(?:lasagna sheets|spaghetti, broken in half|macaroni \((?:4|9)-minute cooking type\)|orzo \(rice-shaped pasta\)|rice-shaped pasta|pasta shells)$

rules.contract: Pecorino-family cheese is reviewed against retained Romano as a generic hard sheep-milk grating-cheese reference. Exact Pecorino variety and added pepper are not certified.
rules.pattern: ^(?:pecorino cheese|peppered pecorino, diced|peppered pecorino cheese, diced|diced peppered pecorino cheese|grated pecorino, to serve|pecorino cheese with pepper|pecorino with black pepper, diced|pecorino, diced|spicy pecorino, diced)$

rules.contract: Grana/Grana Padano is represented by retained hard Parmesan as a generic hard Italian grating-cheese fallback. Protected-origin recipe and exact aging/salt/moisture remain distinct and unclaimed.
rules.pattern: ^(?:grana padano cheese|grana cheese|grana cheese shavings|grams of grana padano|grated grana padano)$

rules.contract: Shortcrust pastry is represented by a retained unbaked pie-crust reference. Deep-dish/frozen/enrichment and butter/shortening formulation are not claimed exact.
rules.fdcDescription: Pie crust, deep dish, frozen, unbaked, made with enriched flour

rules.contract: Unqualified sandwich bread is represented by generic commercially prepared white bread; crust removal/slicing is presentation only, while grain/formulation is not certified.
rules.fdcDescription: Bread, white, commercially prepared (includes soft bread crumbs)
rules.pattern: ^(?:crustless sandwich bread|slices of sandwich bread|sliced sandwich bread)$

rules.contract: Fresh/soft breadcrumbs use the retained white-bread reference that explicitly includes soft bread crumbs; bread formulation remains generic.
rules.fdcDescription: Bread, white, commercially prepared (includes soft bread crumbs)

rules.contract: Unqualified bread slices are represented by generic commercially prepared white bread. The stated piece mass is not used for any inferred conversion here.
rules.fdcDescription: Bread, white, commercially prepared (includes soft bread crumbs)
rules.pattern: ^(?:bread slices, cut \(25 g each\)|crumbled bread slices \(25 g each\))$

rules.contract: Romanesco is a cauliflower cultivar and is represented by retained raw cauliflower. Cultivar-specific composition and cooked state are not inferred.
White wine vinegar uses the retained generic vinegar category because the exact subtype is absent. Acid concentration and wine-vinegar formulation are not certified.

tiers.A: Direct food/state family or presentation-only variant.
tiers.B: Explicit generic category fallback; not exact subtype/species/brand/formulation certification.
